profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer in Austin. (she/her)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Implement and integrate new 3rd party apis including Twilio, Formstack, SureScripts, and Stripe.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Worked on integrating Care and Marketing network integrations. Integrated new APIs to our products. I led a monthly meeting for backend engineers to share their work, while also fostering community in our backend slack channel with a "Question of the Week."

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Worked on the Marketing infrastructure team improving our ingestion pipeline and monitoring.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I was a backend engineer on the Organic Publishing team within Marketing. I was also in charge of a biweekly meeting with 40 engineers. Additionally, I was the Engineering Intern Program Associate Director for Summer 2018.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description: Intern on the Google Classroom team. My intern project was the backend for Calendar Integration for Google Classroom. It launched in early September.

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description: Intern on the Advertising: Test team to create automated testing for another Ads team
